name: 999 - SPIKE - Xero API check (not part of the skill)

parameters.content:
## Xero API spike — run this once, by hand

**This is not part of the skill.** It is never installed and never runs on its
own. It exists to answer one question that cannot be answered from the
outside: does Xero hand back bank statement lines through the ordinary
Accounting API for *your* organisation?

Before running it you need the `Xero (read-only)` credential from
`docs/XERO_RECONCILIATION.md` Step 2, connected to a real or demo
organisation.

Select **Execute workflow**, then open the last node and copy the `summary`
value. That text is the answer.

It only ever reads. There is no create, update or delete anywhere in it.
